_flags.measuredDomain (actors/commitments.ts:28: fallback when a domain has no benchmark fit: measuredL + (v.domains[d] − v.Lg), the TRUE domain offset. Only hit for versions in evaluation / domains without a fit; each domain here carries fitted:true/false
_flags.stackViews inModel / gap (models/researc: reads base.ePre and v.build.eRL/aRL (hidden build) and true stack buckets (stackAt); DROPPED. knowhow.areas[].waiting_believed = Σ believed est of ideas adopted after the internal model froze its recipe (computed here)
_flags.softwareRate.oomPerYear (researchView.ts: gRate is the change of researchG (true buckets); DROPPED. Used ownGrowthLast365d_believed (Σ est of ideas adopted in the last 365 d) and publicPerYear (stack bases: public, visible)
_flags.runCard g / limits.gGain / limits.gPre (: G gained, recipe and pretraining G come from the plan on the TRUE stacks (ePreAt on buckets); the Blueprint shows "G gained" — DROPPED here. band/domains are runForecast (measured reference + step) and are kept
_flags.medianExpertLevel (capability.ts:53), mi: read s.hidden.timeline (world gSC, dBM) and version G; not used. Median-expert tick = the framework High trigger level stored in player state (set from it at game start, shown on the framework panel)
_flags.techniqueRows / sightGrid levels ↔ OOM (: the level→OOM map is a hidden world parameter; believed strength itself is from posteriors. Kept (the UI shows it) but flagged
_flags.tokEff (worldfx/serving.ts:56) in Models: reads v.build (eRL/aRL: reasoning-token efficiency); cost per hour here is useHourCost(fpt) WITHOUT tokEff, as Blueprint shows it
_flags.jobs (skill at job, can do alone): no believed readout: workFit / coverage are computed from the version G; only horizon50 (benchmark) is given
